| **7.4.1** | Verify that a generic message is shown when an unexpected or security sensitive error occurs, potentially with a unique ID which support personnel can use to investigate. | 1 | 210 |

Here are 2 requirements:
* do not show a technical error message to output
* show unique ID for support

First, this "potentially" is... noise.

I think the first part is worth being a level 1 and this unique ID can be level 3.

Just showing a unique ID does not make sense, it requires support from the company/organization process, and it is a separate topic from "do not show details to output", so I propose to split this.

comments.body: I don't think the 2nd part is a requirement, it is more like a functional idea. I am happy to drop it but at the same time I would like to be a little clearer about the risk here in terms of disclosing sensitive data.

I think dropping the second part is best, too. 

Perhaps:

_Verify that a generic message is shown when an unexpected or security sensitive error occurs, so that sensitive internal system data is not leaked._
Thanks @jmanico I opened PR  #2639 where I refined your wording slightly. @elarlang would also appreciate your input
